invariants.invariant: glc balance: V_e dC_glc = integral of the face fluxes and the cells' exchange plus the glucose released by matrix breakdown (trapezoid; 1e-3 of the amount moved)
invariants.expr: abs(V_e*(C_glc[-1] - C_glc[0]) - np.trapz((fN__J_glc_down + fS__J_glc_up) + j_glc_cell + V_e*f_mx_glc*k_mx*C_mx, t)) <= 1e-3*np.trapz(np.abs(fN__J_glc_down) + np.abs(fS__J_glc_up) + abs(j_glc_cell), t) + 1e-30

invariants.invariant: lac balance: V_e dC_lac = integral of the face fluxes and the cells' exchange (trapezoid; 1e-3 of the amount moved)
invariants.expr: abs(V_e*(C_lac[-1] - C_lac[0]) - np.trapz((fN__J_lac_down + fS__J_lac_up) + j_lac_cell, t)) <= 1e-3*np.trapz(np.abs(fN__J_lac_down) + np.abs(fS__J_lac_up) + abs(j_lac_cell), t) + 1e-30

invariants.invariant: H balance: V_e*(1 + b_H) dC_H = integral of the face fluxes and the cells' exchange (trapezoid; 1e-3 of the amount moved)
invariants.expr: abs(V_e*(1 + b_H)*(C_H[-1] - C_H[0]) - np.trapz((fN__J_H_down + fS__J_H_up) + j_H_cell, t)) <= 1e-3*np.trapz(np.abs(fN__J_H_down) + np.abs(fS__J_H_up) + abs(j_H_cell), t) + 1e-30

invariants.invariant: O2 balance: V_e dC_O2 = integral of the face fluxes and the cells' exchange (trapezoid; 1e-3 of the amount moved)
invariants.expr: abs(V_e*(C_O2[-1] - C_O2[0]) - np.trapz((fN__J_O2_down + fS__J_O2_up) + j_O2_cell, t)) <= 1e-3*np.trapz(np.abs(fN__J_O2_down) + np.abs(fS__J_O2_up) + abs(j_O2_cell), t) + 1e-30

invariants.invariant: matrix balance: V_e dC_mx = integral of the matrix delivered less breakdown and overflow (trapezoid; 1e-3 of the amount moved)
invariants.expr: abs(V_e*(C_mx[-1] - C_mx[0]) - np.trapz(j_mx_cell - V_e*(r_mx + r_ovf), t)) <= 1e-3*np.trapz(j_mx_cell + V_e*(r_mx + r_ovf), t) + 1e-30

invariants.invariant: carbon (glucose units): V_e (C_glc + C_mx) changes by the face and cell glucose fluxes and the matrix delivered, less J_mx_lost (trapezoid; 1e-3 of the amount moved)
invariants.expr: abs(V_e*((C_glc[-1] + C_mx[-1]) - (C_glc[0] + C_mx[0])) - np.trapz((fN__J_glc_down + fS__J_glc_up) + j_glc_cell + j_mx_cell - J_mx_lost, t)) <= 1e-3*np.trapz(np.abs(fN__J_glc_down) + np.abs(fS__J_glc_up) + abs(j_glc_cell) + j_mx_cell + J_mx_lost, t) + 1e-30

invariants.invariant: carbon held: V_e (C_glc + C_mx) + N_mx_lost changes only by the face and cell glucose fluxes and the matrix delivered (trapezoid; 1e-3 of the amount moved)
invariants.expr: abs(V_e*((C_glc[-1] + C_mx[-1]) - (C_glc[0] + C_mx[0])) + N_mx_lost[-1] - N_mx_lost[0] - np.trapz((fN__J_glc_down + fS__J_glc_up) + j_glc_cell + j_mx_cell, t)) <= 1e-3*np.trapz(np.abs(fN__J_glc_down) + np.abs(fS__J_glc_up) + abs(j_glc_cell) + j_mx_cell + J_mx_lost, t) + 1e-30

invariants.invariant: definitions (exact): phi = v_mx C_mx, f_hind = ((1 - phi)/(1 + phi))^2, pH = -log10(C_H/c_std), J_mx_lost = V_e ((1 - f_mx_glc) k_mx C_mx + k_ovf C_mx (C_mx/C_mx_max)^8)
invariants.expr: np.allclose(phi, v_mx*C_mx, rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.allclose(f_hind, ((1 - phi)/(1 + phi))**2, rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.allclose(pH, -np.log10(C_H/c_std), rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.allclose(J_mx_lost, V_e*((1 - f_mx_glc)*k_mx*C_mx + k_ovf*C_mx*(C_mx/C_mx_max)**8), rtol=1e-12, atol=0)

invariants.invariant: steady state of the lactate and O2 by t_end (no source in the volume): the face fluxes balance the cells' exchange (1e-6 of the largest term)
invariants.expr: abs((fN__J_lac_down + fS__J_lac_up)[-1] + j_lac_cell) <= 1e-6*max(np.max(np.abs(fN__J_lac_down)), abs(j_lac_cell), 1e-30) and abs((fN__J_O2_down + fS__J_O2_up)[-1] + j_O2_cell) <= 1e-6*max(np.max(np.abs(fN__J_O2_down)), abs(j_O2_cell), 1e-30)

invariants.invariant: with no cell exchange the concentrations stay between the open-water values and their start (maximum principle; glucose may rise by the matrix it releases)
invariants.expr: (j_lac_cell != 0) or (np.all(C_lac >= min(C_lac[0], fN__C_lac_up[0], fS__C_lac_down[0]) - 1e-12) and np.all(C_lac <= max(C_lac[0], fN__C_lac_up[0], fS__C_lac_down[0]) + 1e-12))

invariants.invariant: the matrix stays between 0 and its densest gel plus 15% (overflow holds the ceiling)
second law: each species diffuses down its gradient across both faces, J (C_upstream - C_downstream) >= 0
invariants.expr: np.all(fN__J_glc_down*(fN__C_glc_up - C_glc) >= -1e-30) and np.all(fS__J_glc_up*(fS__C_glc_down - C_glc) >= -1e-30) and np.all(fN__J_lac_down*(fN__C_lac_up - C_lac) >= -1e-30) and np.all(fS__J_lac_up*(fS__C_lac_down - C_lac) >= -1e-30) and np.all(fN__J_H_down*(fN__C_H_up - C_H) >= -1e-30) and np.all(fS__J_H_up*(fS__C_H_down - C_H) >= -1e-30) and np.all(fN__J_O2_down*(fN__C_O2_up - C_O2) >= -1e-30) and np.all(fS__J_O2_up*(fS__C_O2_down - C_O2) >= -1e-30)
